description: Fork of exp706 (1.4371 @ 84.94M, <90M SOTA) adding a per-block backward_lut: E->E that predicts BLOCK INPUT from BLOCK OUTPUT with auxiliary detached MSE loss. 6 layers x backward_lut(NAP=5, tph=256, n_heads=1, n_out=E=96) = +4.72M -> ~89.66M total. Loss = main_ce + aux_backward_weight * sum(per_layer_mse). aux_backward_weight=0.5, constant schedule, target.detach() so backward_lut fits the existing layer outputs without distorting forward state. All other config identical to exp706 (E=96, d_v=16, bs=16, 8K steps, lion lut_lr=2e-4, hybrid_smooth backward). Comparison anchors: exp706=1.4371 @ 84.94M, exp696=1.4247 @ 100.67M.
